ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with localized high-intensity (white/off-white) circular and linear pixel clusters; ratio favors low-intensity pixels approximately 9:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black/dark grey base across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white focal spot at the central peduncle junction. Global distribution of small, high-contrast white circular rings (scars) throughout the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a wide vertex angle (~110-120 degrees) and deep central bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (1-5px depth) occurring continuously along the trailing boundary of both left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight linear trajectory before terminating in irregular, ragged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed spatial clusters of white circular rings (barnacle scars) distributed globally; highest density observed on the mid-to-outer sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-aligned high-contrast linear streaks observed on the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme raggedness and potential tissue degradation (irregular pixel voids) at both the left and right distal tips compared to the smoother primary trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Physical protruding clusters of high-intensity, high-texture matter (active barnacle colonization) localized specifically at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
